📌 The Right Approach to Write Essay for IAS (150+ Marks) — By Vikash Ranjan
✍️ Dear Student,

📝 Essay writing is a thoughtful, analytical, insightful, compact and focused exercise in communication. It reflects not merely what you know, but how you understand, organise and interpret ideas. An essay is not a long factual note. It is not a collection of unrelated points gathered together mechanically. It is not an emotional outburst or ideological activism. Rather, it is a balanced and structured discussion that explores all dimensions of a topic and develops a central argument with clarity and coherence.

🚨 The UPSC notification clearly states: Candidates will be expected to keep closely to the subject of the essay, to arrange their ideas in orderly fashion and to write concisely. Credit will be given for effective and exact expression.”

🔥 An effective essay generally consists of three major parts: OPENING PARAGRAPH – Introduction;  THE BODY – Main Discussion; CLOSING PARAGRAPH – Conclusion

💬 The Introduction - The introduction leads the reader into the topic and clarifies the broad direction of the essay. It establishes the central idea or thesis that runs throughout the essay.

⭐️ The Body - The body develops the core arguments and dimensions of the essay. Each paragraph should deal with one major idea and should be supported by explanation, examples, illustrations and analysis.

⌛ The Conclusion - The conclusion brings the discussion together and leaves the evaluator with a sense of completeness. It may offer a solution, a futuristic perspective or a balanced reflection.

✏️ Ultimately, an essay should move from the general to the specific and then back to the general again. This gives the essay continuity, coherence and intellectual completeness.
